Alex: Quick weekly NovusHealth sync — WoW tokens +18%, QoQ +62%. P95 latency 420ms (+30ms WoW), errors 0.8% (was 0.2%), spend +13% WoW. Flagging for follow-up.
Jesse: Nice ramp. Which routes are driving the tokens — chat vs embeddings?
Alex: Mostly chat (/v1/chat ~45%) then embeds (~25%) and a new rerank route (~18%). Rest is small.
Mina: Any recent model swaps or config changes? That latency jump could be batching or variant related.
Alex: They moved to `redwood-xl-q4` last Tue and increased client concurrency. We suspect KV cache misses on long sessions.
Taylor: I'll ping @eng-runtime and prepare a canary rollback plan. Can you attach session examples?
deploy-bot: New deploy: redwood-xl-q4 promoted to dedicated pool for NovusHealth at 2026-03-18T09:12Z :rocket:
Jesse: Can you also share token-length distribution? If avg prompt+context grew, cache pressure makes sense.
Priya: I'll refresh the billing forecast — if spend stays +13% WoW we breach their committed tier by month-end. Renewal risk increases.
Alex: Renewal risk = medium for now. Action items: Mina enablement workshop, Taylor coordinate eng-runtime canary/rollback, Priya update forecast, I will pull KV logs + token histograms.
Mina: I can run a 1-hr enablement session Thurs — cover batching, streaming, token budgets, best prompt practices. Slide draft by Wed.
Taylor: Opened INF-5421 with eng-runtime, assigned to Sam. ETA 48h. Will test rolling back to `redwood-xl-q3` in staging canary.
Alex: My quick query I used to pull daily tokens and p95: ```sql
SELECT day, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95_latency
FROM inference_metrics
WHERE account = 'novus' AND day >= '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day;
```
Sam: Got the ticket, will investigate KV cache miss rate and prefix reuse. Will report back on hot spots and suggestion (cache warming, session pinning, or revert).
Alex: Great — will follow up Friday with updated numbers and the sample sessions. :thumbsup:
